profile.description: Visa entry rules by passport and destination.
profile.readme: Visa Rules Guide answers questions about entry requirements. Tell it your passport country and where you are going and it summarises visa-free days, e-visa options and transit rules from official sources it was given. It does not file applications and rules change often, so always check the embassy page before you travel. Built for backpackers and travel agents who need a quick first answer.
starter_prompts: Do I need a visa for Japan with an Indian passport?
